description_en: For scenarios involving fully Japanese-language image documents, this feature provides efficient Detection and recognition of printed Japanese text, and supports multiple Basic Features such as rotation, tables, and text coordinates.
description_zh: 针对全日文图片文档场景下日文印刷体高效检测和识别，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-janpanese --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/igoptb/%E6%97%A5%E8%AF%AD%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --output-char-info false --need-rotate false --output-table false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeJanpanese

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must be no longer than 2048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Binary image file, up to 10 MB in size. You must specify either this parameter or the URL parameter. To use HTTP invocation, place the binary image file in the HTTP body. To use the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output per-character recognition results
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出单字识别结果
parameters.name: output_char_info

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. Rotation is automatically applied in structured detection, mixed-layout scenarios, and education-related scenarios, so you do not need to set this parameter in those cases. The rotation angle is included in the response.
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要自动旋转功能（结构化检测、混贴场景、教育相关场景会自动做旋转，无需设置），返回角度信息
parameters.name: need_rotate

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output table recognition results, including cell information
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息
parameters.name: output_table

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Data.example: {"content":"いくら飞すか (多少钱?) ","height":384,"orgHeight":384,"orgWidth":512,"prism_version":"1.0.9","prism_wnum":2,"prism_wordsInfo":[{"angle":-89,"direction":0,"height":508,"pos":[{"x":2,"y":85},{"x":509,"y":85},{"x":509,"y":170},{"x":2,"y":170}],"prob":99,"width":84,"word":"いくら飞すか","x":213,"y":-126}],"width":512}

Message.description_en: Error message (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
